messages.subject: Discussion on exploratory-analysis-of-raw-data
parts:
When I run this command:

lapply(cs, writeImage, tags="rainbow", palette=rainbow(256))

which gives me the following information:
Loading required package: EBImage
$`VCGS-HS05_04v00028 250K 05-03-2007`
[1] "reports/DamienBruno/raw/Mapping250K_Nsp/spatial/VCGS-
HS05_04v00028 250K 05-03-2007,rainbow.png"

$`VCGS-HS05_07v00516 250K 05-03-2007`
[1] "reports/DamienBruno/raw/Mapping250K_Nsp/spatial/VCGS-
HS05_07v00516 250K 05-03-2007,rainbow.png"

Warning message:
Packages reordered in search path: package:EBImage in: fcn(...)

in the resulting folder structure reports/.../spatial, there are a
number of .png files. However if I look at the file type, these are
not recognised as .png:

> file *
MIFF image data

I have been using the convert command of ImageMagick to change these
to recognised .png files for viewing (I have been unable to view the
original .png files). Is it possible to generate 'true' .png files
the first time around? (note, this is with aroma.affymetrix v0.4.3).
cheers

Lavinia.

messages.author: 185f4d4fdb048fb8
messages.subject: Re: [aroma.affymetrix] Discussion on exploratory-analysis-of-raw-data
parts:
Hi.

My best guess is that there is a problem with your EBImage/ImageMagick
setup. The aroma.affymetrix package calls write.image() of EBImage
which deduce the file/image format from the filename extension, i.e.
*.png. I have never seen this problem. Play around with the examples
in EBImage in a fresh R session and see if you can reproduce it there.
Then contact Oleg Sklyar, the maintainer of EBImage.

FYI: I just generated spatial plots in aroma.affymetrix on WinXP with
EBImage v1.9.29 and ImageMagick 6.2.7 05/26/06 Q16 and they are "real"
PNGs.

Cheers

Henrik
